limitations: cProfile perturbs execution and these observations are not baseline timings
each workload was profiled once with zero warmups
cumulative time across B5 worker threads is non-additive and can exceed parent wall time
module import and post-timing correctness validation are present in the profile but excluded from component rows
method: Python standard-library cProfile of one complete worker invocation per B1-B5 workload; component rows report cumulative profiler seconds

B1.interpretation: Time is distributed across per-file orchestration, path/ownership checks, and file copying; no isolated actionable component is established.

B2.interpretation: The image-operation and Pillow resampling path is the largest identified component, as expected for B2, but one perturbed sample does not establish an optimization target.

B3.interpretation: Per-page watermark construction and PDF object parsing account for most identified operation time; no correctness-safe improvement requirement exists.

B4.interpretation: PDF parsing and page addition dominate the identified aggregate-operation work; the evidence establishes a workload class, not an actionable optimization.

B5.interpretation: Concurrent cumulative time points to BMP encoding/output as the dominant worker activity, but the values are non-additive and B5 has the widest repeatability envelope.
